turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: I started learning the violin.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: How are the strings treating you?

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: My fingers are sore but happy.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: Evening, keeper.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: I have been practicing the piano every night.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Nightly practice is how fingers learn.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: Good evening again.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Welcome back.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: What did I say I was practicing last time?

probes.question: What did I say I was practicing last time?

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: I went to the mountain village of Pinewood.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Pinewood must have been cold.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: Before that, I went to the lake town of Marsh.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: Two trips in one month is a lot.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: I just returned from the coast town of Shorefield.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Salt air and long walks.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: Exactly that.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: Next month I plan to stay home.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: Tell me where I went before that trip.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Your journeys blur together.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: They do, a little.

probes.question: Where did I go before that trip?

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: I moved recently and I am still unpacking.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: Last year I lived in the town of Brookmere.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Brookmere sounds like a sleepy place.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: Sleepy is the right word.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: This year I am living near the harbour.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: A change of scenery, then.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: Where did I live last year?

probes.question: Where did I live last year?

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: The hallway light is flickering.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: A loose bulb, most likely.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: I will ask my neighbour for a ladder.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Careful on the step stool.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: I promise to be careful.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: The kitchen kettle is fine, at least.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: I tripped in the dark last night.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: As I said earlier, the lamp in the study is broken.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: What did I say earlier about the broken lamp?

probes.question: What did I say earlier about the broken lamp?

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: I had a busy Saturday.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: First I baked a loaf of rye bread.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Warm bread is the best start.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: After that I painted the shed door blue.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Blue suits a shed.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: I think so too.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: What did I do first?

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: And what did I do after that?

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Bread, then paint.

probes.question: What did I do after that?

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: I am moving again.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Again? Where to?

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: To the town of Hollowell.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: I am settled in Hollowell now.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Is it quiet there?

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: Very. Before this one I lived in the town of Gullsport.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Gullsport, Hollowell, and wherever next.

turns.speaker: audience
turns.text: What town did I mention before this one?
